title: Naturality of the localized tensor braiding
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and $W$ a scheme on whose residue fields $\ell$ is invertible. Use the integral and rational tensors of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the prescribed signed braidings of [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. Suppose the integral braiding is natural for every pair of integral arrows. Then its prescribed rational localization is natural for all raw rational arrows: for $f:M\to M\prime$ and $g:N\to N\prime$, $\beta_{M\prime,N\prime}\circ T(f,g)=T(g,f)\circ\beta_{M,N}$. No restriction to lattice-preserving arrows is imposed.

proof.text: Use the specified bilinear formulas for rational tensor and the localization formula for the rational braiding. On pure tensors both sides reduce to the integral braiding naturality equation; induction on both tensor factors gives all localized arrows.
